title: New Transmitter not connecting, Sensor Status stuck on 'Stopped', multiple queued items in Status page. Nothing is working... HELP!
body: Today I changed my transmitter over. I had a brain-fart moment and hit 'forget device' on the transmitter status page, before realising my blunder and proceeding to the setting tab to update the transmitter ID. But even before this with my old sensor and transmitter which stopped randomly after 9 days, my for nearly 18 hours the status just says 'Stopped' highlighted in brown, and on the main readings page there is also a permanent 'Stopped' notification. I have changed my sensor and begun the process or warm up but the notification remains, nothing happens but the increase of queued items in the status section. Why has my equipment/application just died? New sensor, newly connected transmitter. I have reset my phone, restarted the app. Nothing. What can I do to ensure 1) the new transmitter is connected correctly? How can I force thru the queued items and stop this 'Stopped' notification? Please help me... I dont know what else to do

comments.body: the same here!! I didn´t do anything... Xdrip stopped working with my G6, did the same and nothing really worked out... Any ideas?????

@njrfoto please double double check that you have the new transmitter id entered correctly. Keep the G6 status tab open and watch it for 5 minutes - does it proceed from scanning to connecting with the transmitter? If so then select stop sensor and then start sensor and try again. Make sure you are running a current version of xDrip
Simple answer is to change to these settings, restart your collector, wait 5 minutes, and it will work.
